pages.text: Finds all entities near a position.$(br2)Items count as entities too. Each ENTITY has uuid, type, name and position. $(1)radius$() must be 1 to 64, otherwise INVALID_ARGUMENT is raised.

$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: the center of the search$(li)$(1)radius$() INTEGER: the search radius in blocks, 1 to 64$(li)$(1)type$() STRING: only this entity type (optional, default empty for all types)$(li)result $(1)result$() ARRAY STRUCT c0de/minecraft/ENTITY: the entities found
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/FIND_ENTITIES$(br)  PARAMETER position pen ;$(br)  PARAMETER radius 8 ;$(br)  PARAMETER type "minecraft:sheep" ;$(br)  RESULT result sheep$()
